_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the OpenTTD eggs in https://github.com/pelican-eggs/games-standalone and https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: OpenTTD
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The open source transport simulation game based on Transport Tycoon Deluxe. Installs the chosen OpenTTD release with the OpenGFX graphics, both checked against their published checksums, and continues the last game when the server starts again.
startup: if [ "{{CONTINUE_GAME}}" = 1 ] && [ -f save/autosave/exit.sav ]; then set -- -g save/autosave/exit.sav; fi; LD_LIBRARY_PATH=lib exec ./openttd -D -c openttd.cfg "$@"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# OpenTTD: downloads the chosen OpenTTD release and the OpenGFX graphics from
# OpenTTD's own servers and checks both against their published SHA-256.
# Saves, openttd.cfg, secrets.cfg, AIs and NewGRFs are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
cdn=https://cdn.openttd.org
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
[ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] || fail "OpenTTD's Linux server is only built for x86-64 (amd64) CPUs, and this node is $(uname -m)."

# resolve <category> <version or latest/testing>: the version, and the file's sha256 from its manifest.
resolve() {
    local cat=$1 want=$2 name
    if [ "$want" = latest ] || [ "$want" = testing ]; then
        name=$([ "$want" = latest ] && echo stable || echo testing)
        want=$(get "$cdn/$cat-releases/latest.yaml" | awk -v n="$name" '$1 == "-" && $2 == "version:" { v = $3 } $1 == "name:" && $2 == n && !done { print v; done = 1 }') ||
            fail "OpenTTD's download server can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
        [ -n "$want" ] || fail "OpenTTD has no $name release of $cat right now."
    fi
    echo "$want"
}
sha() { # sha <manifest url> <file>
    get "$1" | awk -v f="$2" '$2 == "id:" && $3 == f { found = 1; next } found && $1 == "sha256sum:" && !done { print $2; done = 1 } $1 == "-" { found = 0 }'
}
fetch() { # fetch <url> <sha256> <dest>
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$3.part" "$1"
    [ "$(sha256sum "$3.part" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$2" ] || { rm -f "$3.part"; fail "The download of ${1##*/} didn't match its published checksum. Reinstall to try again."; }
    mv -f "$3.part" "$3"
}

version=$(resolve openttd "${OPENTTD_VERSION:-latest}")
file="openttd-$version-linux-generic-amd64.tar.xz"
sum=$(sha "$cdn/openttd-releases/$version/manifest.yaml" "$file" || true)
[ -n "$sum" ] || fail "OpenTTD has no version $version for Linux. Set Version to latest, testing, or a release such as $(resolve openttd latest)."
gfx=$(resolve opengfx "${OPENGFX_VERSION:-latest}")
gfile="opengfx-$gfx-all.zip"
gsum=$(sha "$cdn/opengfx-releases/$gfx/manifest.yaml" "$gfile" || true)
[ -n "$gsum" ] || fail "OpenGFX has no version $gfx. Set OpenGFX version to latest, or a release such as $(resolve opengfx latest)."

build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$build"; mkdir -p "$build"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

if [ "$(cat .raptor-openttd 2>/dev/null)" = "$sum" ] && [ -x openttd ]; then
    echo "OpenTTD $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading OpenTTD $version"
    fetch "$cdn/openttd-releases/$version/$file" "$sum" "$build/openttd.tar.xz"
    mkdir "$build/x"
    tar -xJf "$build/openttd.tar.xz" -C "$build/x" --strip-components=1
    cp -a "$build/x/." .
    echo "$sum" > .raptor-openttd
fi

mkdir -p baseset
if [ "$(cat baseset/.raptor-opengfx 2>/dev/null)" = "$gsum" ]; then
    echo "OpenGFX $gfx is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading OpenGFX $gfx"
    fetch "$cdn/opengfx-releases/$gfx/$gfile" "$gsum" "$build/opengfx.zip"
    rm -f baseset/opengfx-*.tar
    unzip -qo "$build/opengfx.zip" -d baseset
    echo "$gsum" > baseset/.raptor-opengfx
fi

if [ ! -f openttd.cfg ]; then
    # Saves the game when the server stops, so the next start continues it.
    printf '[gui]\nautosave_on_exit = true\n\n[network]\nserver_port = 3979\n' > openttd.cfg
fi
# The passwords, which OpenTTD keeps apart from openttd.cfg.
[ -f secrets.cfg ] || printf '[network]\n' > secrets.cfg
echo "Installed OpenTTD $version with OpenGFX $gfx."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The OpenTTD release to install, such as 15.3, latest for the newest stable release, or testing for the newest beta.

variables.name: OpenGFX version
variables.description: The OpenGFX graphics release to install, such as 8.0, or latest.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name shown in the server list.

variables.name: Visibility
variables.description: public lists the server, invite-only lets players join with its invite code, and local accepts only direct connections.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players that can be connected at once.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players need to join. Empty lets anyone join.

variables.name: Rcon password
variables.description: The password for the remote console. Empty turns it off.

variables.name: Continue last game
variables.description: Load the game saved when the server last stopped, instead of starting a new map.
